messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired PD-INC-9102 — high 5xx rate detected in inference-gateway-usw2. 5m 5xx rate=12% (threshold 5%). Affected route: /v1/generate (model-x). Auto-escalation to oncall.

mike: I'm oncall — acked via PD. Starting triage now. :white_check_mark:

anya: @mike any customer-facing errors or just internal spikes?

mike: Seeing customer retries and elevated client errors for a handful of accounts. 3 customers with >10% error rate in last 10m. Logs show repeated kvcache timeouts and backend 502s.

devon: No deploy in the last 30m from what I can see. Autoscaler shows a few OOM eviction events earlier.

mike: Quick plan: 1) shift traffic off model-x in usw2 (slice), 2) scale gateway pool, 3) warm KV cache and increase eviction thresholds. Doing step 1 now.

pagerbot: Route slice command executed: removed 20% traffic from model-x in inference-gateway-usw2 -> success :white_check_mark:

anya: Noted. I'll loop in support for the three impacted customers and start a ticket for visible errors.

mike: Kicking scale: `infractl scale inference-gateway --pool gw-usw2 --delta 4` — running now.

infra-bot: Scale job queued (job id: 8921). Estimated finish ~2m.

mike: KV warmup script queued: `./ops/warm_kv.sh --region=usw2 --pattern=model-x-prefix*`

devon: quick log snippet from gateway: ```2026-03-12T02:45:12Z kvcache.go:214 timeout fetching key batch (context deadline exceeded)  (# attempts=3)``` Looks like hot-prefix churn causing backend stress.

infra-bot: Scale job complete. Pools increased +4 instances in gw-usw2. Health checks passing.

pagerbot: KV warm job completed, hit rate improved for model-x prefixes.

mike: Metrics update: 5xx 5m rate down to 3.4% after slice+scale+warm. Continuing to monitor for 15m. I'll set PD snooze for 30m.

anya: Adding initial impact note to incident doc: suspected kvcache eviction under high prefix churn. Customer tickets opened for the three accounts.

mike: Handing off monitoring and follow-up to day oncall @sara for the 08:00 shift. I'll add mitigation steps to the incident page and leave runbook TODOs.

sara: Ack — taking over. Please add exact commands you ran so we can reproduce if it reoccurs.

mike: Added commands and short RCA notes to the incident doc. Main mitigation: traffic slice, scale pool, KV warm + adjust eviction policy. Leaving link: https://console.redwood.example/incidents/PD-INC-9102

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-INC-9102 mitigated (status: monitoring). Will auto-close if no regression in 60m. :signal_strength:
